text:
Nia Brooks: Hey team — thinking of a midweek unwind: street-tacos + lightning trivia this Wednesday? 6:30pm start near the La Calle food truck lot. Bright lights, short rounds. :taco::zap:
Owen Garcia: love that. are we doing teams or free-for-all?
Nia Brooks: teams of 3 max. keep it quick. prizes = bragging rights + a $25 gift card for the winners.
Priya Desai: count me in. i can host one trivia round (tech + pop culture mix).
Tom Baker: can we make it BYOB? or is there a beer stand?
Riley Park: there's a pop-up bar next to the lot. they do flights. also i can bring a bluetooth speaker.
Owen Garcia: quick emoji poll  react :taco: if you want tacos, :pizza: if you'd prefer pizza, :beer: if drinks-only/just hang.
Nia Brooks: :taco:
Priya Desai: :taco:
Tom Baker: :beer:
Riley Park: :taco:
Owen Garcia: :taco: (but pizza is my backup)
Nia Brooks: RSVP summary so far: Nia, Owen, Priya, Tom, Riley. anyone else? bring friends allowed but please note on the RSVP.
Priya Desai: heads-up: one of my friends is vegan. is there a vegetarian option at the truck?
Riley Park: yes, they do a grilled veggie taco and a jackfruit option. clearly labeled.
Tom Baker: can we pin a fallback indoor spot if it rains? i'm not brave enough for drizzle tacos.
Nia Brooks: fallback = The Alcove (indoor pub two blocks away). I've asked them to hold an area.
Owen Garcia: can someone throw this on the calendar? i keep forgetting midweek stuff.
calendar-bot: Event created  "Weeknight Street Tacos + Lightning Trivia" Wednesday 6:30 PM. RSVP: https://cal.example.com/event/5582
Nia Brooks: added the event link above  please RSVP and indicate +1s. i'll bring score sheets and a tiny trophy.
